svg.text: driver_j1BigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
driver_j2BigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
driver_zBigTreeTech TMC2209 V1.3 StepStick stepper driver
mains_inletIEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch
V24 24 V from PS2: load 3.216 A typical, 5.36 A peak; source 6.5 A cont, 7.1 A peak
V12 12 V from PS1: load 0.9 A typical, 3.15 A peak; source 6 A cont, 6.6 A peak
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_v24) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
